chung.Pre-Requisite:
o Pass SAP331 (BA), SAP341 (IT)

o Complete (*) other subjects of combo SAP and PMG20xc (x = 1, 2)

o Chuyên ngành BIT_SE: SWP391

o Chuyên ngành BIT_IS: ISP392

(*): GPA must be greater than or equal to 4.
chung.Description:
The SAP inter-disciplinary capstone project provides IT and BA students with important skills and initial experiences in participating in the SAP projects. With the team size of 3-5 members (*), student can apply knowledges and skills they have learned to the real current projects, including:

- Understand the lifecycle of a SAP project

- Know what to do in each phase of the project

- Understand the terminology used in the project lifecycle

- Practice teamwork and how to interact with colleagues in a project implementation process

- Ensure the proper implementation of quality requirements and schedule

- Do troubleshooting

All the documents in the project implementation process and the progress reports are required to write in English.

(*): Unless impossible, the team should consist of IT and BA students with a recommended IT to BA student ratio of 3:2. In case of only IT students, the team will have to do all the work assigned to BA students under the guidance of BA lecturer.
chung.StudentTasks:
# Choose appropriate project and form group.

# Divide and schedule work among members.

# Attend all scheduled meeting with supervisor.

# Produce document and product according to project requirement and member work share.

# Defend work in front of examination board, showing both project results and individual responsibility.

# In case of cheating found, the whole team is not allow to defend.

# Students are required to attend at least 80% of scheduled meetings with their supervisor(s) to be eligible for the thesis or capstone defense.
